description: Encode verified G6PD-drug rules for all high-risk drugs listed in CPIC G6PD guidelines (G:PA166119846 and G:PA166279621): dapsone, methylene-blue, pegloticase, rasburicase, tafenoquine, toluidine-blue, primaquine. G6PD deficient patients must receive 'avoid' for all these drugs; G6PD variable patients receive 'conditional' for primaquine. Add one E-* evidence record, append rules to data/rules/pgx.json, add reference test cases. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 — purely additive. DEPENDS ON: FEAT-001 having been committed (Windows path fix must be in place).
steps:
STEP 1 — Add one E-* evidence record to data/evidence.json (append to the 'evidence' array):
  { id:'E-CPIC-G6PD-2023', org:'CPIC', title:'Expanded Clinical Pharmacogenetics Implementation Consortium Guideline for Medication Use in the Context of G6PD Genotype', url:'https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC10281211', year:'2023', type:'primary_guideline', retrieved:'2026-10-13', note:'CPIC 2023 G6PD guideline; covers high-risk drugs causing haemolytic anaemia in G6PD-deficient patients including dapsone, methylene blue, pegloticase, rasburicase, tafenoquine, toluidine blue. The earlier 2014 guideline (PMC4111801) covered rasburicase specifically.' }

STEP 3 — Append one G6PD-variable 'conditional' rule for primaquine to data/rules/pgx.json.

  R-PGX-PRIMAQUINE-G6PD-VARIABLE: drug='primaquine', condition={type:'pgx', gene:'G6PD', phenotypeIn:['variable']}, action='conditional', headline='Primaquine use requires specialist review in G6PD-variable patients', rationale='CPIC notes that for patients with G6PD variable phenotype (typically heterozygous females with intermediate activity), the recommendation is to consider prescribing primaquine at a reduced dose with enhanced monitoring; the guideline recommends specialist review rather than automatic avoidance.', mechanism='G6PD-variable females have intermediate enzyme activity that may not fully protect against oxidant-induced haemolysis; susceptibility depends on the degree of X-chromosome inactivation.', monitoring=['Haemoglobin monitoring before and during treatment if primaquine is used.'], limitations=['The CPIC guideline provides a nuanced recommendation for variable patients; specific dosing is in the guideline and is not encoded here.'], evidence=['E-CPIC-G6PD-2023','G:PA166279621'], alternatives={supported:false}

STEP 4 — Add reference test cases to tests/fixtures/reference_cases.js. Append to the CASES array:

  // G6PD drugs
  { id:'dap-g6pd-def', source:'CPIC G6PD 2023 (ClinPGx PA166119846)', drug:'dapsone', patient:P({},{'G6PD':'deficient'}), expected:'avoid' },
  { id:'dap-g6pd-nm', source:'CPIC G6PD 2023 (ClinPGx PA166119846): normal G6PD — no flag', drug:'dapsone', patient:P({},{'G6PD':'normal'}), expected:'no_flag' },
  { id:'mb-g6pd-def', source:'CPIC G6PD 2023 (ClinPGx PA166119846)', drug:'methylene-blue', patient:P({},{'G6PD':'deficient'}), expected:'avoid' },
  { id:'peglo-g6pd-def', source:'CPIC G6PD 2023 (ClinPGx PA166119846)', drug:'pegloticase', patient:P({},{'G6PD':'deficient'}), expected:'avoid' },
  { id:'rasb-g6pd-def', source:'CPIC G6PD 2023 (ClinPGx PA166119846)', drug:'rasburicase', patient:P({},{'G6PD':'deficient'}), expected:'avoid' },
  { id:'taf-g6pd-def', source:'CPIC G6PD 2023 (ClinPGx PA166119846)', drug:'tafenoquine', patient:P({},{'G6PD':'deficient'}), expected:'avoid' },
  { id:'tolb-g6pd-def', source:'CPIC G6PD 2023 (ClinPGx PA166119846)', drug:'toluidine-blue', patient:P({},{'G6PD':'deficient'}), expected:'avoid' },
  { id:'prim-g6pd-def', source:'CPIC primaquine/G6PD (ClinPGx PA166279621) + PA166119846', drug:'primaquine', patient:P({},{'G6PD':'deficient'}), expected:'avoid' },
  { id:'prim-g6pd-var', source:'CPIC primaquine/G6PD (ClinPGx PA166279621): variable requires specialist review', drug:'primaquine', patient:P({},{'G6PD':'variable'}), expected:'conditional' },
  { id:'prim-g6pd-nm', source:'CPIC primaquine/G6PD (ClinPGx PA166279621): normal G6PD — no flag', drug:'primaquine', patient:P({},{'G6PD':'normal'}), expected:'no_flag' }
